# Project instructions

Read these files before work; paths are relative to the repository root:

- Repository rules: [workflow](docs/repository/WORKFLOW.md),
  [Git delivery](docs/repository/DELIVERY.md), [Tracker](docs/repository/TRACKER.md),
  [verification](docs/repository/VERIFICATION.md).
- System meaning and implementation: [project](docs/system/PROJECT.md) and
  [context](docs/system/AGENT_CONTEXT.md).
- Environment access and operational safeguards: [runtime](docs/runtime/DELIVERY.md).
- Machine-readable project settings: `delivery.json` and `tracker/config.json`.

Follow [file ownership](docs/repository/LAYOUT.md) when adding or updating files.

## Description
<!-- Write 2–4 plain-English sentences: what changes, why it matters, and the expected result. Use verified context. Replace this comment with real prose. -->

## Specifications
### Context and expected behavior
<!-- Explain the current situation and the requested behavior so an agent can continue without the chat. Include relevant edge cases and authoritative links. -->

### Scope and constraints
<!-- State what is included, what must remain unchanged, dependencies and applicable operational boundaries. Do not invent implementation decisions. -->

### Acceptance criteria
<!-- Add observable results before implementation. A rough Idea may record known context and explicitly defer undecided criteria. -->

### Implementation and verification
<!-- Record established contracts, relevant files/links, technical decisions and meaningful checks. Distinguish facts, proposals and unknowns. Keep secrets out. -->

### Handoff
<!-- Maintain current progress, remaining work, blockers, branch/PR and verified results here. Date historical evidence; distinguish merge, deployment and a confirmed release. Preserve original requirements/history when enriching an existing task. -->

Tracker issues: ACL-12

## Result

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Title: `[ACL-12] Summary`. Opted-in
execution v1 requires exactly one task per source PR; multiple related IDs are
legacy-only. Link this PR back from its Issue(s).

## Verification

Self-checks and results. Independent reviewer/report and exact reviewed version.
For an adopted instruction-only source: complete eligible-diff proof, current
main/scope, explicit process checks and idle integration/stage ownership.
For stage promotion: source PR, same single task (related sets are legacy-only),
verified tree and environment proof.

## Documentation and related processes

Current system/history updated, or no impact with reason.
Master Repo / Task Tracker impact: linked matching change, or no impact with reason.
Local exceptions and deployment controls preserved. Completion and delivery still
pending, where applicable. No automatic closing keywords.

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, ready_for_review]
jobs:
  tracker-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Verify the tracked task
        run: python3 scripts/tracker_pr_check.py --pr "$PR_NUMBER"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

# Tracker workflow

Run `python scripts/task_tracker.py guide` to read the pinned shared workflow. Read `tracker/config.json` for project IDs and module boundaries. Every implementation, including immediate fixes, needs an Issue before code. Use `python scripts/task_tracker.py work ID` or `work --title ... --body-file task.md --module ... --type ...` and verify In Progress. Every new task starts with a plain-English Description written by the agent from the request and verified context, followed by Specifications with verified context, behavior, scope, criteria, checks and current handoff. Read the complete Issue body; only the UI collapses Specifications. Use tracker/task-template.md; empty or placeholder Description/Specifications sections are rejected. Preserve existing task scope and history; review a sample before any bulk retrospective rewrite. Planning only creates tasks. Release uses one --release flag. Run check-pr before merge and the verified merged transition after complete review. Follow existing repository review and release rules.

This project adopts the shared delivery policy. Read the pinned guide and `docs/DELIVERY.md`. Use `check-merge` immediately before merge, record independent review, and use `stage` / `verify-stage` when staging is enabled. A Merged label alone is not completion; record verified delivery when required. Preserve the working branch through stage fixes.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Project-local client for the pinned shared tracker; Python 3.11+ and gh."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    lock = json.loads((root / 'tracker/engine.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    repo, revision = lock['repository'], lock['revision']
    if repo != 'MojoTheApe/task-tracker' or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', revision):
        raise ValueError('Expected the approved shared tracker repository and a pinned full commit SHA')
    override = os.environ.get('TASK_TRACKER_HOME')
    engine = Path(override).resolve() if override else root / '.tracker-runtime' / revision
    if not engine.exists():
        if override: raise ValueError('TASK_TRACKER_HOME does not exist')
        engine.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        subprocess.run(['gh', 'repo', 'clone', repo, str(engine), '--', '--no-checkout', '--filter=blob:none'], check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(engine), 'checkout', '--detach', revision], check=True)
    actual = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(engine), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
    if actual != revision:
        raise ValueError('Shared tracker checkout does not match tracker/engine.json; use its exact revision')
    if subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(engine), 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no'], text=True).strip():
        raise ValueError('Shared tracker checkout has modified tracked files; inspect it before execution')
    # Explicit import path prevents ACL's retained compatibility package shadowing the shared engine.
    code = 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv.pop(1)); from tracker.cli import main; raise SystemExit(main())'
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', code, str(engine), '--config', str(root / 'tracker/config.json'), *sys.argv[1:]], cwd=root).returncode


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try: raise SystemExit(main())
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print('Tracker client failed: ' + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Resolve an authorized batch and record native verified delivery with a repo token.

Exported beside the portable admission helpers. This module cannot merge, deploy,
approve tasks or create authorization. Project-owned trusted workflows perform
delivery and emit the receipt only after their actual acceptance checks.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import copy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
from urllib.parse import quote

try:
    from . import delivery_policy as rules
except ImportError:
    import tracker_delivery_policy as rules

MARKER = 'TRACKER_DELIVERY_RECEIPT '
WORKFLOW = re.compile(r'\.github/workflows/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.ya?ml\Z')


class PendingDelivery(ValueError):
    """The authorized coordinator has not completed its main handoff yet."""


def github(path, method='GET', payload=None):
    command = ['gh', 'api', '--method', method, path]
    if payload is not None:
        command += ['--input', '-']
    result = subprocess.run(command, input=json.dumps(payload) if payload is not None else None,
                            text=True, encoding='utf-8', capture_output=True, timeout=90)
    if (result.returncode and path.endswith('/logs')
            and 'pass --allow-escape-sequences' in result.stderr):
        # Recent gh versions reject colored Actions logs even when captured.
        # Opt in only for privately captured logs; never print terminal escapes.
        # Older gh versions need no new flag and retain their compatible path.
        result = subprocess.run(command + ['--allow-escape-sequences'], text=True,
                                encoding='utf-8', capture_output=True, timeout=90)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError('GitHub delivery request failed; inspect state before retrying')
    if path.endswith('/logs'):
        if len(result.stdout.encode()) > 8 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError('Native verification log exceeds proof bound')
        return result.stdout
    return json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout.strip() else None


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()


def configuration(request, repo, revision):
    root = 'repos/' + repo
    row = request(root + '/contents/tracker/config.json?ref=' + quote(revision, safe=''))
    config = json.loads(rules.file_bytes(request, root, row))
    if config.get('project', {}).get('repository') != repo or not rules.batch_mode(config):
        raise ValueError('Use the configured official batch project')
    return config


def state(request, repo):
    root = 'repos/' + repo
    row = request(root + '/contents/.tracker-state.json?ref=tracker-state')
    shared = json.loads(rules.file_bytes(request, root, row))
    rules.state_schema(shared)
    if shared.get('maintenance'):
        raise PendingDelivery('Delivery continuation is paused by owned maintenance; resume after cutover')
    return shared, row['sha']


def official_run(request, repo, run_id, revision):
    if type(run_id) is not int or run_id < 1:
        raise ValueError('A real native workflow run is required')
    run = request(f'repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}')
    if (run.get('head_sha') != revision or run.get('head_branch') != 'main'
            or run.get('event') not in ('push', 'workflow_dispatch', 'workflow_run')
            or run.get('head_repository', {}).get('full_name', '').lower() != repo.lower()
            or not WORKFLOW.fullmatch(run.get('path', ''))):
        raise ValueError('Native run must belong to this official main revision and trusted workflow')
    return run


def authorization(config, batch):
    auth = batch.get('delivery_request')
    if not auth:
        return None
    if (auth.get('schema_version') != 1 or type(auth.get('schema_version')) is not int
            or auth.get('state') != 'requested'
            or auth.get('batch_id') != batch.get('id') or auth.get('issues') != batch.get('issues')
            or auth.get('target') != rules.policy(config)['delivery_target']
            or rules.reconciled_request_policy(auth, batch) != rules.fingerprint(config)
            or not WORKFLOW.fullmatch(auth.get('workflow', ''))
            or not isinstance(auth.get('job'), str) or not auth['job'].strip()
            or not isinstance(auth.get('requested_at'), str)
            or not auth.get('actor') or not auth.get('session')):
        raise ValueError('Durable delivery authorization changed or belongs to another policy/target')
    return auth


def task_context(request, repo, config, shared, batch, merge_sha):
    """Validate against the exact snapshot that will supply the final CAS SHA."""
    section = rules.execution_state(shared, config)
    issues, members = batch.get('issues', []), batch.get('members', [])
    if (batch.get('state') != 'merged' or not issues or len(issues) != len(set(issues))
            or [m.get('issue') for m in members] != issues):
        raise ValueError('The unchanged completed batch must still own every delivery member')
    tasks = shared.get('delivery_workflow', {}).get('tasks', {})
    already_verified = True
    for number in issues:
        item = request(f'repos/{repo}/issues/{number}')
        labels = {x['name'] for x in item.get('labels', [])}
        row = tasks.get(str(number), {})
        effective, reconciled_scope = rules.reconciled_policy(row)
        member = next(m for m in members if m['issue'] == number)
        execution = section.get('tasks', {}).get(str(number), {})
        statuses = [s for s in labels if s.startswith('status:')]
        merged = ['status:' + (s if isinstance(s, str) else s['id']) for s in config['workflow']
                  if (s if isinstance(s, str) else s['phase']) == 'merged']
        if (statuses != merged or {'flag:archived', 'flag:blocked'} & labels or row.get('process')
                or item.get('state_reason') == 'not_planned' or 'pull_request' in item
                or effective != rules.fingerprint(config)
                or (reconciled_scope or member.get('scope')) != rules.task_scope(item)
                or execution.get('state') != 'merged' or execution.get('batch_id') != batch['id']
                or {s.get('merge_sha') for s in row.get('sources', [])} != {merge_sha}):
            raise PendingDelivery('Every frozen task needs its exact reviewed main merge receipt first')
        verification = row.get('verification') or {}
        already_verified = already_verified and (row.get('state') == 'verified'
            and verification.get('result') == 'passed'
            and verification.get('target') == rules.policy(config)['delivery_target']
            and merge_sha in verification.get('merge_shas', []))
    return tasks, already_verified


def resolve(repo, merge_sha, ci_run, *, request=github, include_delivered=False):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+', repo) or not rules.SHA.fullmatch(merge_sha):
        raise ValueError('Supply official repository and exact main merge SHA')
    source_config = configuration(request, repo, merge_sha)
    run = official_run(request, repo, ci_run, merge_sha)
    if run.get('status') != 'completed' or run.get('conclusion') != 'success':
        raise ValueError('Main CI has not succeeded on the exact delivery revision')
    root = 'repos/' + repo
    current = request(root + '/git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha']
    config = configuration(request, repo, current)
    original, active = rules.policy(source_config), rules.policy(config)
    if ({k: v for k, v in original.items() if k != 'staging'}
            != {k: v for k, v in active.items() if k != 'staging'}
            or original['staging']['branch'] != active['staging']['branch']
            or rules.execution_policy(source_config) != rules.execution_policy(config)):
        raise ValueError('Current delivery target, checks, completion or execution differs from the authorized source')
    if request(root + '/compare/' + merge_sha + '...' + current).get('status') not in ('ahead', 'identical'):
        raise ValueError('Delivery version is no longer included in main')
    shared, _ = state(request, repo)
    section = rules.execution_state(shared, config)
    matches = []
    for batch in section.get('batches', {}).values():
        if batch.get('state') != 'merged' or not batch.get('delivery_request'):
            continue
        for number in batch.get('main_prs', []):
            pr = request(root + f'/pulls/{number}')
            if pr.get('merge_commit_sha') == merge_sha:
                matches.append((batch, pr))
    if len(matches) > 1:
        raise ValueError('Ambiguous authorized main batch; inspect retained evidence')
    if not matches:
        held = section.get('integration') or {}
        if held.get('delivery_request'):
            heads = [m.get('head_sha') for m in held.get('members', [])]
            if heads and all(request(root + '/compare/' + h + '...' + merge_sha).get('status')
                             in ('ahead', 'identical') for h in heads):
                raise PendingDelivery('Record the admitted main merge and finish its Coordinator handoff first')
        return {'eligible': False, 'reason': 'No completed batch authorized delivery for this main revision'}
    batch, pr = matches[0]
    auth = authorization(config, batch)
    issues = batch.get('issues', [])
    members = batch.get('members', [])
    if (not issues or len(issues) != len(set(issues)) or any(type(n) is not int or n < 1 for n in issues)
            or [m.get('issue') for m in members] != issues
            or not pr.get('merged') or pr.get('base', {}).get('ref') != 'main'
            or pr.get('base', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name', '').lower() != repo.lower()
            or re.findall(r'^Tracker batch:\s*([a-f0-9]{32})\s*$', pr.get('body') or '', re.M) != [batch['id']]):
        raise ValueError('Delivery requires the actual admitted full-member main PR')
    _, already_verified = task_context(request, repo, config, shared, batch, merge_sha)
    if already_verified and not include_delivered:
        return {'eligible': False, 'reason': 'The exact authorized batch delivery is already verified'}
    tree = request(root + '/git/commits/' + merge_sha)['tree']['sha']
    return {'eligible': True, 'schema_version': 1, 'repository': repo, 'batch_id': batch['id'],
            'issues': issues, 'main_pr': pr['number'], 'merge_sha': merge_sha, 'tree_sha': tree,
            'policy': rules.fingerprint(config), 'target': auth['target'],
            'workflow': auth['workflow'], 'job': auth['job'], 'requested_at': auth['requested_at'],
            'authorization_sha256': digest(auth),
            'ci_run': ci_run}


def verification_job(request, repo, run_id, name, attempt):
    """Find the latest actual verifier, retaining success across downstream reruns."""
    # A partial rerun increments run_attempt without rerunning successful upstream
    # jobs. Inspect the native attempts instead of requiring the latest attempt
    # to contain the verifier or trusting an optional job.run_attempt property.
    if type(attempt) is not int or not 1 <= attempt <= 100:
        raise ValueError('Native verification attempt is invalid or exceeds proof bound')
    for actual_attempt in range(attempt, 0, -1):
        found = []
        for page in range(1, 101):
            rows = request(f'repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{actual_attempt}/jobs?per_page=100&page={page}')
            jobs = rows.get('jobs')
            if not isinstance(jobs, list):
                raise ValueError('Native verification attempt membership is unavailable')
            found.extend(j for j in jobs if j.get('name') == name)
            if len(jobs) < 100:
                break
        else:
            raise ValueError('Native verification job pagination exceeds proof bound')
        if found:
            if len(found) != 1:
                raise ValueError('Native verification job identity is ambiguous')
            return found[0], actual_attempt
    raise ValueError('Verification job is absent from every native run attempt')


def verified_native(request, document, receipt, run_id, job_id):
    repo = document['repository']
    run = official_run(request, repo, run_id, document['merge_sha'])
    if run.get('path') != document['workflow'] or type(job_id) is not int or job_id < 1:
        raise ValueError('Verification workflow differs from the authorized project producer')
    job = request(f'repos/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}')
    if (job.get('run_id') != run_id or job.get('name') != document['job']
            or job.get('head_sha') != document['merge_sha']
            or job.get('status') != 'completed' or job.get('conclusion') != 'success'):
        raise ValueError('The exact authorized verification job has not passed')
    latest, _ = verification_job(request, repo, run_id, document['job'], run.get('run_attempt', 1))
    if latest.get('id') != job_id:
        raise ValueError('A later native verification job supersedes this report')
    log = request(f'repos/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs')
    if not isinstance(log, str) or len(log.encode()) > 8 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError('Native verification log is unavailable or oversized')
    proofs = []
    for line in log.splitlines():
        if MARKER in line:
            try:
                value = json.loads(line.split(MARKER, 1)[1])
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                continue
            if value == receipt:
                proofs.append(value)
    if len(proofs) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Receipt must match one actual successful native acceptance report')


def record(document, receipt, run_id, job_id, *, apply=False, request=github):
    if not document.get('eligible'):
        raise ValueError('There is no authorized delivery request')
    actual = resolve(document['repository'], document['merge_sha'], document['ci_run'], request=request,
                     include_delivered=True)
    if (receipt.get('kind') != 'delivery-verification' or receipt.get('result') != 'passed'
            or receipt.get('target') != document['target'] or receipt.get('merge_shas') != [document['merge_sha']]
            or not isinstance(receipt.get('checks'), list) or not receipt['checks']
            or any(not isinstance(x, str) or not x.strip() for x in receipt['checks'])
            or not isinstance(receipt.get('report'), str) or not receipt['report'].strip()):
        raise ValueError('A passed exact-target/revision delivery verification is required')
    repo = document['repository']
    shared, sha = state(request, repo)
    current = request('repos/' + repo + '/git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha']
    config = configuration(request, repo, current)
    batch = shared.get('execution', {}).get('batches', {}).get(document['batch_id'], {})
    auth = authorization(config, batch)
    if not auth or digest(auth) != actual.get('authorization_sha256'):
        raise ValueError('Authorization changed before receipt write')
    if actual != document:
        # A retained successful native report can predate a staging-only audit.
        # Accept only an actual earlier prefix of that SAME immutable request's
        # validated reconciliation chain; all task/source/producer fields match.
        ignored = {'policy', 'authorization_sha256'}
        same = ({k: v for k, v in actual.items() if k not in ignored}
                == {k: v for k, v in document.items() if k not in ignored})
        prefixes = []
        for length in range(len(auth.get('policy_reconciliations', [])) + 1):
            previous = copy.deepcopy(auth)
            previous.pop('policy_reconciliations', None)
            if length:
                previous['policy_reconciliations'] = auth['policy_reconciliations'][:length]
            prefixes.append(digest(previous) == document.get('authorization_sha256')
                            and rules.reconciled_request_policy(previous, batch) == document.get('policy'))
        if not same or not any(prefixes):
            raise ValueError('Delivery request is stale or changed; resolve the same authorized batch again')
        document = actual
    if rules.fingerprint(config) != document['policy']:
        raise ValueError('Delivery policy changed before receipt write')
    if document['main_pr'] not in batch.get('main_prs', []) or batch.get('issues') != document['issues']:
        raise ValueError('Main handoff changed before receipt write')
    tasks, _ = task_context(request, repo, config, shared, batch, document['merge_sha'])
    native = {'run': run_id, 'job': job_id, 'workflow': document['workflow'],
              'authorization_sha256': document['authorization_sha256']}
    if all(tasks[str(n)].get('state') == 'verified'
           and tasks[str(n)].get('verification') == receipt
           and tasks[str(n)].get('native_delivery') == native for n in document['issues']):
        return {'applied': False, 'already_recorded': True, 'issues': document['issues']}
    verified_native(request, document, receipt, run_id, job_id)
    if all(tasks[str(n)].get('state') == 'verified'
           and tasks[str(n)].get('verification') == receipt
           and {k: v for k, v in tasks[str(n)].get('native_delivery', {}).items() if k != 'job'}
               == {k: v for k, v in native.items() if k != 'job'}
           for n in document['issues']):
        # A successful uncertain CAS may be followed by a downstream-only rerun.
        # GitHub can clone upstream success under a new job ID. Fresh native proof
        # above validates the clone; retain the originally recorded job/evidence.
        return {'applied': False, 'already_recorded': True, 'issues': document['issues']}
    at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()
    for number in document['issues']:
        row = tasks[str(number)]
        if row.get('state') == 'verified':
            raise ValueError('Verified delivery already exists; preserve it instead of replacing evidence')
        row.setdefault('history', []).append({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in row.items() if k != 'history'})
        row.pop('policy_reconciliations', None)
        row.update(policy=document['policy'], state='verified', verification=copy.deepcopy(receipt),
                   verified_at=at, native_delivery=native)
    if apply:
        root = 'repos/' + repo
        # CAS failure/uncertain response is never retried with a stale body.
        request(root + '/contents/.tracker-state.json', 'PUT', {
            'message': 'Record verified authorized delivery [skip ci]', 'branch': 'tracker-state', 'sha': sha,
            'content': base64.b64encode(json.dumps(shared, indent=2).encode()).decode()})
    return {'applied': apply, 'issues': document['issues'], 'result': 'passed'}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    p = commands.add_parser('resolve')
    p.add_argument('--repository', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--merge-sha', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--ci-run', type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    p = commands.add_parser('record')
    p.add_argument('--request', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--evidence', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--verification-run', type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--verification-job', type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--apply', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == 'resolve':
        value = resolve(args.repository, args.merge_sha, args.ci_run)
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    else:
        value = record(json.loads(args.request.read_text()), json.loads(args.evidence.read_text()),
                       args.verification_run, args.verification_job, apply=args.apply)
    print(json.dumps(value))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except PendingDelivery as error:
        print(str(error))
        raise SystemExit(75)
    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print('Delivery continuation refused: ' + str(error))
        raise SystemExit(1)

# Repository workflow

Read `delivery.json`, `docs/system/PROJECT.md`, `docs/repository/DELIVERY.md` and
`docs/repository/TRACKER.md` before work. They define this project's adopted
standard, system, tracker, stage option, completion rule and local exceptions.
Use `python scripts/task_tracker.py guide` for the pinned Tracker commands.
Use [verification](VERIFICATION.md) for selecting checks and retaining reusable
results under this project's exact standard pin.

If matching descriptor/Tracker `process_instructions` is explicitly adopted,
one source PR changing only regular AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or Markdown under
docs/repository goes through independent review and its instruction checks directly
to main. The complete actual diff must qualify, including both rename paths;
mixed, unknown, unsafe or incomplete proof keeps the normal route. Keep the genuine
author claim/handoff and, when execution is adopted, its review lane through admitted main completion. Do not move
this source to Approved, stage or a batch or invent installation proof. Wait for
any reserved integration/unpromoted stage ownership to finish before changing main.
Later staged work starts from current main. Use the pinned Tracker's baseline proof
for a complete instruction-only gap covered by retained verified process merges;
missing receipts or other divergence needs ordinary claimed reconciliation.
Configuration, helpers, CI, system/runtime knowledge and application/build changes
remain on the ordinary route. Installing a skill alone never selects the exception.

If matching execution policies use schema 2 or 3, follow the pinned guide's Approved
and batch-integration lifecycle for all other work. Each source PR still represents one task; current
independent review and required source checks move it to Approved and release the
review lane. A development request ends there until integration is authorized.
A separate Coordinator claim owns one frozen integration batch of
1..batch_limit members (recommended limit five), retaining every real Worker and
reviewer. Ship-all snapshots current Approved intake; new arrivals wait. An urgent
single task may ship alone. Independently review/check the combined candidate,
with staging enabled verify its exact stage target/tree, then promote the unchanged
member set to main. With staging explicitly disabled, admit the reserved independently
reviewed batch directly into main using the pinned `batch` direction and matching
batch identity. Ordinary source PRs remain approval-only; keep all source and
combined checks.
Keep failed post-stage batches owned through claimed author fixes and fresh proof.
Explicit schema 3 adds 1..5 independent source-review slots, with distinct actual
Reviewer runs/claims and one separate integration Reviewer. Schema 2 retains one
source slot. Source approvals may continue during ordinary batch review; each
source return/takeover/evidence operation selects its exact claim. Instruction-only
sources retain their idle-integration restrictions. Opt-in requires compatible
published writers/service and an idle preserved-state migration under the pinned
guide; changing configuration alone cannot reserve more capacity.
The execution-v1 lane lifetime and single-task staging instructions below apply
only to schema 1. Installing a skill or changing upstream pins does not enable v2.

Create an Issue before implementation. Idea requests stay Idea; task requests
start Backlog. Start development only when requested; claim the Tracker slot and
use the pinned task-branch rules (`codex/<public-id>-<short-name>` remains
compatible; opted-in execution also accepts `work/<public-id>-<short-name>`).
Honor a host/user prefix requirement. PR title: `[ACL-12] Summary`; one
`Tracker issues: ACL-12` line, with a link back from the Issue. Opted-in execution v1
requires exactly one task per source PR. Multiple related IDs in one PR are allowed
only under legacy execution. No automatic closing keywords.

If `workflow.execution` and Tracker `execution_policy` are explicitly enabled and
equal, use their implementation capacity and version-specific ownership. Schema 1
has one review/integration lane; schema 2/3 separates source review from a Coordinator
integration batch. Otherwise
keep the pinned legacy slot behavior. A Coordinator stays in the current
conversation, screens task dependencies/overlap and delegates independent tasks to
Workers in separate branches/worktrees using available subagents. Two independent
tasks with two free slots use two Workers. Use platform-neutral opaque actor and
session IDs; record Worker ownership separately from coordinator/reviewer metadata
and real GitHub Assignees. No new user-owned conversations without an explicit
request. If delegation is unavailable, disclose serial implementation; never
substitute self-review for an independent Reviewer.

Use the pinned Tracker guide to claim, resume, hand off and recover work. In schema 1, handoff
to the review queue releases implementation capacity. Multiple tasks may wait in
Review; acquire the sole review/integration lane before launching a Reviewer. Hold
it through current review, checks, optional stage and main merge. The next task
waits until explicit release. Review fixes take priority and reacquire implementation
capacity. Preserve current source/base/policy evidence and stage ownership when
returning work or recovering; no timeout or label change permits duplicate claims.
Any post-handoff branch edit, including base updates and conflict resolution,
requires the Reviewer to call `execution review-return`, followed by a fresh author
implementation claim, checks and another handoff. Use `--keep-lane` to retain review
ownership; it is mandatory after entering stage. Reacquire or resume the lane and
review current content. Coordinators and Reviewers never edit an unclaimed branch.

After implementation and self-check, prepare the PR and set Review. Automatically
arrange a separate non-implementing subagent for independent review when the lane
is available. Delegated Workers hand off to the Coordinator, who starts the review
of the actual
head/base, requirements and docs. Fix on the same branch and obtain fresh approval.
Run `check-merge PR_NUMBER` immediately before merging. For a proven adopted
instruction-only source, main integration completes the fully reviewed task scope,
including in a package project; supply no Stage or installation receipt. Legacy
projects keep their slot and independent attestation without unsupported execution
lane commands. For other work, in schema 1 or legacy mode, if staging is enabled,
working branch -> stage -> main, using the same single task in execution v1
(related task sets are legacy-only) and unchanged verified
content. Preserve the working branch for fixes. Use evidence commands from the
Tracker guide; labels and merge alone do not prove a required delivery.

Update current-system docs and meaningful change history in the same PR, or explain
no documentation impact. Preserve original specifications and local deployment
controls. A selected integration/main-merge request includes the maintained release,
verification and receipt after main; continue without a routine second approval
through [delivery continuation](DELIVERY_CONTINUATION.md). A configured adapter/CI
supplies durable execution; instructions alone do not launch it. Assess Master Repo /
Task Tracker impact for process changes and propose
linked fixes when needed. Ordinary feature work does not upgrade the standard.

The optional installed `project-workflow` skill helps navigate these instructions.
Its canonical source lives in Master Repo; updating that skill never changes this
project's pinned contract. Record project-specific exceptions in `delivery.json`.

File ownership and placement: see `docs/repository/LAYOUT.md`.

# Verification policy

Follow the [shared verification policy](https://github.com/MojoTheApe/master-repo/blob/a3f56106f52d0ae19986920519b2fa46a380798b/docs/verification.md)
at this project's exact standard pin. `delivery.json` defines actual product
commands/required CI names; retain matching Tracker settings, runtime checks and
local exceptions. Separate fast source feedback, combined-candidate integration
and actual delivery acceptance. Select by changed risk, not a desired green result.

Preserve the adopted collector's existing bounded reuse rules. Expand context
proof only through reviewed compatible support/adoption; the common policy alone
cannot add an unsupported environment signature. Run missing jobs/platforms.
Preserve independent combined review, exact stage target and package/production
proof. Inspect passing unchanged evidence before rerunning; add checks for changed
inputs, findings, missing scope or unresolved concerns. Cancel obsolete PR runs,
preserve admitted integration push evidence and measure costs before pruning tests.

For an authorized standard upgrade, use the
[coordinated procedure](https://github.com/MojoTheApe/master-repo/blob/a3f56106f52d0ae19986920519b2fa46a380798b/docs/workflow-upgrades.md).
Only the exact compatible Tracker guide supplies commands. A newer standard/skill
cannot activate an unimplemented maintenance or evidence collector.

# Authorized delivery continuation

Follow the [shared continuation contract](https://github.com/MojoTheApe/master-repo/blob/a3f56106f52d0ae19986920519b2fa46a380798b/docs/delivery-continuation.md)
at this project's exact standard pin and [runtime procedure](../runtime/DELIVERY.md).
Under this adopted flow, owner approval to integrate/merge selected tasks into
main covers review/checks,
optional stage, admitted main merge, maintained delivery, verification and final
Tracker receipt. The owner need not also say “and deliver”. Starting development
or source approval alone does not authorize integration/deployment.
Do not request another routine owner approval after main; report a concrete missing
permission, access or failed check instead.

The Coordinator must continue or hand off durably to the configured project CI.
Shared templates do not create a release/deploy mechanism or a background agent.
For compatible runtime/package batches, the Coordinator persists this standing
authorization by default with `batch begin --deliver --delivery-workflow PATH --delivery-job
EXACT_NAME`, selecting the real project native verification producer. This is an
agent implementation detail, not another approval. Honor explicit source-only or
merge-only/skip-release instructions; deferred runtime delivery stays unfinished.
Use the maintained separate release path when later authorized rather than adding
permission by resuming an old batch. Arbitrary main pushes cannot authorize release. A trusted
workflow can use the exported `tracker_delivery_receipt.py resolve`/`record` with
a same-repository token, successful main CI, actual Merged handoff and exact native
verification job/log proof. Follow the pinned guide; the portable recorder creates
no authorization or deployment. No private engine access token is required.

Before claiming it works automatically, implement and test the project's actual
adapter, including a failed run, resumable retry and duplicate request.

Persist exact merged revision/tree, task set, configured target and run/artifact
identity; serialize changes per target and prevent stale runs replacing newer work.
Verify actual profile-specific acceptance, then record delivery through the exact
pinned Tracker and read back completion. Preserve failed/pending tasks and evidence.
A receipt retry must not repeat a completed install/deploy or create a new version.

Tooling/local and explicitly n8n-source work retains admitted reviewed-merge
completion. Package requires stable publication and agreed installation verification;
VPS/ordinary n8n requires actual configured production behavior. Preserve local
release, credential, backup, rollback and separate authorization controls.

# File ownership

Paths in this document are relative to the repository root.

| Area | Contents | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/repository/` | Git, tasks, review, checks, adoption and repository change history | Shared process, with reviewed project exceptions |
| `docs/system/` | What the product does, architecture, requirements, domain constraints and system history | Project |
| `docs/runtime/` | Environment identities, credentials handling, operational authorization, deployment, backup and recovery | Project |
| `.workflow/tools/` | Shared exported Tracker helpers | Pinned shared template |
| Application directories | Workflows, generators, tests and product scripts | Project |

`AGENTS.md` is a short reading map. Keep substantive rules in the appropriate
area. Business rules belong to the system, even when an agent must follow them.
A new Git rule belongs to repository guidance. An instruction to access, publish
or test a live environment belongs to runtime guidance. Link between the areas
instead of copying their rules into each other. Mixed legacy documents must be
split by section, preserving their requirements and dated evidence.

`delivery.json` and `tracker/config.json` are the small machine-readable bridge:
they identify checks and completion policy and may link project procedures. They
are not places for a product specification or full operational runbook.

New projects receive starting outlines in `docs/system/` and `docs/runtime/`.
Those files become project-owned immediately, even before they are customized.
Standard upgrades never replace, merge or delete their contents. Missing required
project documents need explicit repair in a project PR. The recorded template
baseline stays pristine; it is not a backup or authority for project knowledge.

Upgrades of an earlier mixed layout stop without writes for an audited migration.
Move the original material, adjust links, preserve local safeguards and record the
move map. Old paths may remain short forwarding files; do not maintain two copies
of the rules. Existing `scripts/task_tracker.py` and related helper paths are
compatibility entry points only; implementations live in `.workflow/tools/`.

This layout alone changes no task status, delivery policy or deployment connection.
The separately adopted `process_instructions` option selects an instruction-only
integration route; follow the pinned workflow and actual diff classification.

# Project delivery

`delivery.json` is the project-specific delivery description. `tracker/config.json`
is the matching Tracker configuration. The standard and engine use exact commit
pins; neither automatically follows main. Populate actual procedures and verify
registration before changing adoption from draft to ready.

An explicitly matching `process_instructions` option permits one source PR limited
to proven regular process instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Markdown under
docs/repository) to go Review -> main -> Merged after independent review and its
configured checks. When execution is adopted, keep its real review lane through main completion. No stage,
batch, installer or delivery receipt is created. The full immutable diff, not a
title/label, selects it; mixed/unknown/unsafe or incomplete evidence never does.
Wait for reserved integration/unpromoted stage ownership before changing main.
Later staged work uses current main; the pinned Tracker permits a lagging stage
only through complete eligible-diff and retained verified process merge proof.
Other divergence requires the existing claimed reconciliation procedure.
Application, build, configuration, CI, automation and system/runtime changes keep
their ordinary route and actual delivery requirements.

For other work, execution schema 2 or 3 selects Review -> Approved -> Stage -> Merged
with staging enabled, or Review -> Approved -> Merged with staging explicitly disabled.
Schema 3 permits 1..5 separately owned source reviews and one separate combined
integration reviewer; schema 2 retains one source-review slot. Source approval,
return and takeover select only the exact source claim. Actual consumer activation
requires the pinned guide's idle preserved-state migration and compatible service.
Independent source approval releases the review lane; one separate Coordinator
integration claim covers a frozen batch of 1..batch_limit tasks. The recommended
limit is five, independent of Worker capacity. Preserve each member's author,
source PR/current approval and scope; independently review/check the combined
candidate. With staging enabled verify it before unchanged promotion; otherwise
use the reserved `batch` direction for direct main admission. Ordinary sources
remain approval-only. Ship-all snapshots intake and processes sequential batches,
rechecking remaining approvals after each main change. A single task may ship
without filling the batch. Development alone ends at Approved. A selected
integration/main-merge request covers the maintained chain through verified completion without a routine second
approval after main; the owner need not also request delivery. Eligible runtime and
package batches use `--deliver` by default, honoring explicit source-only or
skip-release overrides while retaining unfinished runtime delivery. Follow
[delivery continuation](DELIVERY_CONTINUATION.md).
The v1 single-task lane instructions below apply only
to schema 1. Completion and runtime authorization remain project-specific.

## Path from request to completion

Idea -> Backlog -> To Do are planning steps under the owner's direction. An
explicit development request starts In Progress and a ticket branch. The author
implements, self-checks and creates the linked PR, then sets Review. A separate
subagent reviews; fixes stay on the same branch and require fresh approval.
Opted-in execution v1 uses exactly one task per source PR and the single
review/integration lane. Use explicit handoff and review claims from the pinned
guide; follow the [workflow](WORKFLOW.md) for author claims before post-handoff edits.

Outside the adopted instruction-only exception, with staging enabled:
working branch -> permanent stage, record Stage, test the
configured target, then stage -> main with the same task and content. Use
merge or squash with an unchanged tree and reviewed first parent. Keep one active
task on stage; a related task set is permitted only under legacy execution.
Reconcile with current main before the next task. If main changes during testing,
opted-in execution requires `execution review-return --keep-lane`, a fresh author
implementation claim, branch updates/checks and handoff before resuming independent
review and staging a fresh candidate. Legacy execution follows its adopted slot rules.
Do not add fixes to the promotion PR or delete the working branch prematurely.

Without staging: legacy/v1 working branch -> main after review and checks;
v2/v3 reserved independently reviewed batch -> main. No Stage column.
Run the pinned client's `check-pr N`, `record-review`, `check-merge N`, `stage`,
`verify-stage` and `merged ... --reviewed-complete --apply` as appropriate; see its
`guide`. Commands record verified actions; they do not deploy or run a reviewer.
Configure branch protection separately and verify that the required checks exist.

Merged records inclusion in main. A proven instruction-only task completes its
fully reviewed instruction scope at that admitted merge, including in a package
project. Legacy projects use their slot and independent attestation; execution
lane commands require an adopted execution policy. A local manual-pull project
also completes at verified merge. For other work, VPS/n8n/package profiles require their actual delivery and checks,
recorded with `record-delivery`. Failed or pending delivery remains unfinished.
The explicitly selected n8n-source profile completes the Git source task after
the admitted main merge. n8n transfer/publication is a separate process and must
never be claimed from Git evidence. Existing runtime acceptance criteria survive
adoption. For repository-only work, label stage evidence as Git checks; consult the project runtime guide when runtime verification is required;
branch-to-environment connections require their own explicit setup.
A partially implemented ticket stays active. Never substitute a closed Issue or
non-code completion for missing code/delivery evidence.

## Procedure references

Use `docs/runtime/DELIVERY.md` for actual environment identities, access,
release authorization, rollback and backup. The descriptor links those procedures. A disabled
stage is an explicit project choice. Production delivery is a separate operation
using the project's maintained mechanism; Git storage gives no new deploy access.
For n8n distinguish workflow publication from server upgrade. For local manual
pull, no installer or automated update mechanism is required.

## Onboarding proof

Record the shared workspace project ID and a durable verification reference after
labels, branch configuration, registry publication and a fresh live board have been
verified. A generated directory or local registry edit is not a connected project.
Document pending setup honestly. Never put credentials or sensitive logs in these
files or in published Tracker evidence.

name: Delivery setup
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, stage]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: delivery-setup-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
jobs:
  descriptor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: MojoTheApe/master-repo@a3f56106f52d0ae19986920519b2fa46a380798b
